rules.title: Java 9 and 10 are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 9 and 10 as non-LTS releases whose Premier Support ended between March 2018 and September 2018. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available.

constraints: Keep the JDK in the build files, the version pin files, CI, and container images on one supported release; a long-term-support release avoids repeating this migration every six months.
Check that the Gradle or Maven version in the project can run on the target JDK (the Gradle compatibility matrix lists the supported Java versions).
A compile level (`maven.compiler.release`, `sourceCompatibility`) is not the JDK that runs the code: lower it only if the code must still run on an older runtime.

steps.title: Move the reported declaration to a supported JDK
steps.instructions: Change the reported version to a long-term-support release (see the replacement) in the build file or the version pin file.

steps.title: Align the other JDK declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other pom.xml, Gradle toolchain, `.java-version`, `.sdkmanrc`, `.tool-versions`, CI JDK setup, and container base image that names the old release, so the repository agrees.

verification.purpose: Build and test the project on the new JDK with the wrapper the project uses.
Confirm the JDK on the path (or the one the toolchain selects) is the intended release.

rules.title: mysql:mysql-connector-java has moved to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j
rules.summary: The POM of mysql:mysql-connector-java 8.0.33 declares a relocation to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j. Its message says: "MySQL Connector/J artifacts moved to reverse-DNS compliant Maven 2+ coordinates."

constraints: Replace mysql:mysql-connector-java with com.mysql:mysql-connector-j; the relocation in the artifact's POM names the new coordinates, so keep the version unless you intend to upgrade it.
Update every module and dependency-management block that names the old coordinates, and remove exclusions that mention them.

steps.title: Align other declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other pom.xml, Gradle build file, version catalog, and BOM override that names the old coordinates.

verification.purpose: Confirm the old coordinates are gone from the resolved dependency graph.
Build and test the project with the new coordinates.
